messages.subject: Re: Temporary delivery hold
messages.body:
We rolled back the quarantine adapter this morning. Its normalized-header dependency was dropping requests on retry. The current adapter sees the raw header and searches for the held alias as a contiguous string. Eli's resolver cleanup is still live downstream.

I've put the actual rollout record under /spool. The older hold instructions describe a different build.

messages.subject: Re: Temporary delivery hold
messages.body: Please open a ticket. If this comes back to us on a weekend, the person on call needs the running version and the rollback scope.
